## Mermaid Diagrams

When the user asks to create, edit, or visualize a diagram, follow the
instructions in `.github/instructions/mermaid.instructions.md`.
<!-- mermaid-ai-skills:end -->

## Model selection

- For typos, corrections, notation, and formatting, use the least costly suitable model.
- For open-ended brainstorming or complex reasoning, use a more capable model.
- Escalate to a more capable model only when the simpler model cannot handle the task.
